subject: Acme Health — pen test artifacts and evidence sourcing for SIG/CaIQ
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: locate pen-test artifacts for Acme Health SIG submission

Team —

Acme (Jordan, security@acmehealth.com) is asking for the pen-test deliverables and supporting artifacts we used to produce the final report (they need them for their SIG / CAIQ evidence package). They specifically call out: the full PDF report, findings export (CSV), PoC artifacts (screenshots/poC), and any test harness logs or raw output that validates remediation status.

We need a consolidated package they can forward to their security reviewers by next Wednesday (2026-08-26). Can each of you confirm what you have and where it lives? Quick asks:
- Dev/Infra: locations for raw logs, packet captures, exploit PoCs, and whether anything is archived.
- Evelyn/Priyom: the canonical findings export and any signed attestation or remediation summary we can include.
- CS (cc'd): Monica, once we have the artifacts, can you handle packaging and the outbound transmittal to Acme? They prefer a single Drive link and a short cover note.

I have the final PDF (redwood_pen_test_report_v3.pdf) in our internal drive but not the raw PoCs. If anyone needs me to open a restore request for archived S3 objects, say so.

Thanks — I'm consolidating this into SEC-4271.

— Olga
Olga Petrov
Product Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: redwood_pen_test_report_v3.pdf (report), SEC-4271 (Jira)
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: locate pen-test artifacts for Acme Health SIG submission

Olga —

I can confirm the following locations and caveats:
- Findings export (CSV): s3://redwood-sec/reports/acme/pt-findings-export.csv (generated by Burp/runner -> normalized).
- PoC artifacts (screenshots + small scripts): s3://redwood-sec/pocs/acme/ (contains screenshots and two .py PoC files).
- Test harness logs: we have 3 zipped log bundles under s3://redwood-logs/pen-tests/acme/2026-07-15/*. Two of those are >1GB and were moved to Glacier on 2026-07-30.

Dylan — the PoCs reference a few kernel trace files and a short tcpdump. If we need packet captures for Acme, we will need a restore from Glacier (estimate ~4 hours for retrieval).

I recommend we package the s3 CSV + PoC screenshots + a short readme mapping findings -> evidence. I can create the readme once Evelyn/Prioym confirm canonical finding IDs.

— Dev
Security Engineer

Attachments referenced: pt-findings-export.csv (S3 path)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: locate pen-test artifacts for Acme Health SIG submission

Olga/Dev —

Quick update from infra: the packet captures and two large trace bundles referenced in the pen-test PoCs are archived in Glacier (s3://redwood-archive/pen-tests/acme/2026-07-15/). If you want those restored to s3://redwood-sec/temp-acme-restore/ I can kick off an expedited restore now — recovery ETA ~4-6 hours depending on size. Note: restoring the largest bundle will incur retrieval charges (~$25-40).

What I can immediately provide without restore: the PoC screenshots and the normalized CSV referenced above (we already copied that to redwood-sec/reports). Exploit binaries are packaged but flagged as restricted — we will only export a tar.gz with a PoC-readme and redacted binary names unless sec signs off.

If you want the full tarball (exploit-pocs.tar.gz) for Acme, Priyom needs to OK export. Otherwise I can provide sanitized artifacts.

— Dylan
SRE Lead

Attachment stubs: exploit-pocs.tar.gz (restricted), S3 paths included
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: locate pen-test artifacts for Acme Health SIG submission

Team —

I reviewed the findings and remediation statuses. Attached is the findings export I signed off on for external delivery (pt-findings-export.csv). High level:
- 14 medium/low items fully remediated (patches deployed + verification tests).
- 3 high items: two are in progress and have mitigations in place; one is pending a design change and will require a scheduled rollout (ETA 2026-09-12).

Export includes columns: finding_id, title, severity, remediation_status, verification_notes, evidence_refs. Please ensure evidence_refs map to the artifacts we put in the Drive link.

Regarding PoCs: I will approve a sanitized exploit-pocs.tar.gz that contains screenshots, safe PoC scripts (non-executable .py.txt), and a readme explaining redactions. No raw exploit binaries will be included. Once Dylan uploads the sanitized bundle to temp-acme-restore, I will sign the export and mark it for delivery.

Monica — please prepare the cover note template; I'll add a short attestation paragraph referencing the CSV and the remediation snapshot.

— Priyom
Senior Security Engineer

Attachment: pt-findings-export.csv (signed), SEC attestation note pending
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: locate pen-test artifacts for Acme Health SIG submission

Thanks everyone — great progress. Summary and next steps: 

1) Items we will hand to Acme (Monica to send):
   - redwood_pen_test_report_v3.pdf (final report)
   - pt-findings-export.csv (signed export attached to this thread)
   - sanitized PoC bundle: exploit-pocs.tar.gz (sanitized per Priyom)
   - readme mapping findings -> evidence (Dev to author)

2) Dylan: please start the expedited restore of the archived bundles and place sanitized tar.gz in s3://redwood-sec/temp-acme-restore/ once ready. Notify Priyom to sign off the bundle.

3) Dev: draft the findings->evidence readme and include S3/Drive paths. Attach sample verification screenshots.

4) Priyom: once you sign the sanitized bundle, please paste the short attestation text into SEC-4271 comments and reply-all here.

5) Monica: aim to deliver to Jordan and security@acmehealth.com with a Drive link and the cover note on 2026-08-26 morning PT. If that changes, flag it here.

I'll create the Drive folder and copy the approved artifacts there; will also update SEC-4271 with the Drive link.

If there are any blockers (cost for restore, export approvals), call them out now. Otherwise I'll proceed with the drive assembly and final outbound.

— Olga
Product Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: planned Drive folder (will contain report, CSV, sanitized tar.gz)
